samples.question: One single turn about one point carries the green shape exactly onto the orange shape. Exactly one of the four blue shapes stands halfway along that motion: one and the same turn carries the green shape onto it, and that very same turn carries it onto the orange shape. All four blue shapes are the same shape in the same orientation, so only their positions differ. The four blue shapes are numbered 1 to 4 from the left. Which one is it? Answer with exactly one of: blue-1, blue-2, blue-3, blue-4.
